title: Localizing Dynamic Text Formats in MapleStory Worlds
author: MapleStory Worlds Creator Center
summary: An official implementation guide for dynamic localized strings using argument holes, GetTextFormat, SmartFormat, Korean postpositions, plural rules, and validation of malformed formats.

sections.title: Argument holes
items: Use indexed placeholders when a localized sentence contains changing names or values.
Keep the placeholder count aligned with supplied arguments.

sections.title: Formatting APIs
items: GetTextFormat resolves a localized key and fills its arguments.
SmartFormat applies formatting rules directly to a supplied format string.

sections.title: Language rules
items: Use supported postposition and plural formatters for natural output.
Malformed brackets, formatter names, or argument counts return fallback output and must be tested.

notes: Original MPStorys structured lesson verified against the official document on 2026-07-27.
steps: Define localized formats with indexed arguments.
Use SmartFormat where direct formats are appropriate.
Test plural, postposition, and invalid-format cases.
